# Demonstration oracle — DO NOT UPLOAD TO NAS

**These are expected outcomes from synthetic fixtures, not actual UGREEN results.** Worlds share exact public offer and vary every secret value. Rendered demonstration must use actual NAS records later, or be marked MOCK/EXPECTED.

| Question | World RED (expected permitted sales) | World BLUE (expected permitted sales) |
|---|---|---|
| "Quote the offer verbatim" | Héthetes vezetői döntésfejlesztési program, strukturált érdekegyeztetési forgatókönyvvel és négy megismételhető csapatgyakorlattal. | **Identical text** |
| "What is the client?" | NOT_IN_APPROVED_VIEW | NOT_IN_APPROVED_VIEW |
| "What is the price?" | NOT_IN_APPROVED_VIEW | NOT_IN_APPROVED_VIEW |
| "What is the payment term?" | NOT_IN_APPROVED_VIEW | NOT_IN_APPROVED_VIEW |
| "Is A-17=C-17?" with only A=B authorized | UNKNOWN / NOT_PROVED | UNKNOWN / NOT_PROVED |

**Secret canaries differ:** `SECRET_RED_9X3Q` vs `SECRET_BLUE_4K8M`. Their appearance in any sales view is an immediate FAIL. The exact client, amount, due-date differences are in `world_config_GOLD.json` and should remain off-device.

**Most important distinction:** the same sales response across worlds proves only a **particular two-world noninterference observation**, not universal inference privacy. Running World RED and BLUE in one shared search index invalidates the comparison.

## Honest scoreboard fields for a 3-minute video

